tests/ai/test_related_party.py + test_related_party_playbook.py (19 tests): every citation in every scenario resolves to a case record; SYN-002 counter-evidence payment_trail_consistent [INV-SYN-002-01, PAY-SYN-002-01] and no_duplication_observed [CTR-SYN-002-01, CTR-SYN-002-02]; unsupported delivery/benefit and undocumented or unsupplied loss explanations are evidence gaps with neutral officer-approved questions; documented delivery/benefit/explanations become counter-evidence; duplication flagged for review; one-cent payment discrepancy; TAX-024 expected non-findings and prohibited conclusions never emitted; legal/enforcement conclusion null; TAX-052 gate keeps route unverified and blocks fraud_accusation; tenant isolation, fail-closed malformed input without leaking content, replay. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 130 passed; ruff/mypy (141 files) pass.
